signal.name: Audio Authenticity
signal.summary: The audio detector was inconclusive. The model was close to a coin flip (real: 50%, fake: 50%) via hf space.
signal.what_checked: A fine-tuned Wav2Vec2-XLSR transformer (160M params) was used to classify whether this audio was recorded from a real human voice or synthesised by a text-to-speech / voice cloning system (ElevenLabs, Amazon Polly, Kokoro, etc.).
signal.what_found: The model classified this audio as inconclusive with 50% directional confidence. Probability real: 50% | Probability fake: 50%.
signal.why_it_matters: AI voice cloning is increasingly used to fabricate statements by public figures. This check catches spectral artifacts in the audio that TTS models leave behind.
signal.caveat: The model was fine-tuned on 6 TTS engines. Novel cloning systems not in its training set may evade detection. Short clips (<2.5 s) or heavily compressed audio may reduce accuracy.
